report.summary: The report's sourcing is generally sound; the vast majority of tagged claims are directly supported by the cited filing excerpts. Two partial verdicts arise from risk-factor sentences that extrapolate slightly beyond the literal wording of the DRHP (loss of client vs. failure to win contracts; negotiating lower bid values). Three untagged claims could be sourced to the DRHP for completeness. No unsupported or wrong-source tags were found, so the report passes the fact-checking gate with zero blocking issues.
